requirements.quote: reuse and move the shared patterns from `packages/adapters/src/workbench/detect.ts` (Aadhaar, PAN, phone, email) into a shared module, and add bank account, vehicle number and address cues.

Legal NER for persons by role: petitioner, respondent, appellant, accused, complainant, witness, relative, other person. An OpenNyAI-style model or rules first; the AI gateway for low-confidence spans, with schema-validated output.
Role placeholders that stay consistent within a judgment ("the Appellant", "Accused 1", "the Complainant's wife").
Kept: judges, advocates, courts, institutions, government bodies, companies, statutes, dates and amounts.

Sensitive categories: POCSO, BNS ss.63–72 and IPC 375–376, 228A, the JJ Act, matrimonial and family matters, in-camera proceedings and acquittals of individuals. These are detected from case type, statutes and title. Victim and minor details are removed outright, and the title is masked.
The placeholder mapping is never stored. `REDACTION_VERSION` is recorded per judgment.
A `corpus_mask_request` global table for court orders and requests: who, what, legal basis, status, and `handled_at`. Add it to the root table list in `packages/db/src/index.test.ts`.

`packages/core/src/corpus/masking.ts`: a staff action to apply a mask request. It masks the title, re-redacts and purges caches within 72 h, and is audited. Register new core exports in `cross-tenant-registry.ts`.
A static test: modules under research, search and the public API never select `judgment.page_text`.

On a labelled set of at least 30 judgments (from #119 or imported ones), person-name recall is at least 0.98 and over-redaction of judges, advocates and institutions is at most 2%. The evaluation report is committed.
Placeholders are consistent within a judgment, and the same person gets the same role label on every page.
Every sensitive-category fixture (POCSO, sexual offence, JJ, matrimonial) has its title masked and no victim or minor identifiers in the output.
Bumping `REDACTION_VERSION` re-redacts affected rows through a job, without re-fetching.
A mask request masks the title and text everywhere it is served (search, API, snippets) and records `handled_at`.

Export the redact module.
storeJudgment redacts before insert and writes redactedText, caseTitle, titleMasked, redactionVersion, sensitiveCategory.
Add judgment columns case_title, title_masked, redaction_version, sensitive_category, mask_reason and redacted_text (jsonb, nullable); add corpusMaskRequest table.
Next free numbered migration (after 20261030000000_corpus_bulk_import) adding the columns and corpus_mask_request (global, no RLS) with the generated snapshot and journal entry; additive only.
Add corpus_mask_request to the root table list.
Cover new columns and table.

Staff service applyMaskRequest: masks title, re-redacts judgment from page_text with the mask applied, clears derived caches, sets status and handled_at, writes an audit event. Plus corpus/index.ts exporting it.
Add corpus.mask_applied audit event.
Job system.corpus.redact: batches judgments with redaction_version below REDACTION_VERSION and re-redacts from page_text without fetching; register in jobs/registry.ts.
Register corpusRedact.
Add system.corpus.redact to the expected job list.
Select and match redactedText instead of pageText; masked judgments never expose raw text.
Static test scanning research, search and public-api modules (allowlisting citations/verify.ts and masking/redact internals) for page_text/pageText selects.
Register new core runtime exports (applyMaskRequest etc.) in SERVICE_TESTS or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason (global table).
Real case for any SERVICE_TESTS entry added.
Integration test: mask request masks title and text, records handled_at, is audited.
Export the corpus masking service if the barrel lists domains; add CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES and docs/engineering/core-domains.md entries for a new corpus domain if the domain test requires them.

decisions.choice: Store redacted pages in a new nullable judgment.redacted_text jsonb column rather than judgment_segment.
decisions.justification: judgment_segment does not exist yet (only specified in docs/adr/0051-corpus-storage-enrichment-and-retrieval.md:70-82); the issue scopes columns to judgment. A later segmentation issue will derive segments from redacted_text.

decisions.choice: Reuse patterns via the existing @causedeck/adapters/workbench export; no new workspace dependency.
decisions.justification: packages/intelligence/package.json:32 already depends on @causedeck/adapters; packages/adapters/package.json:10 exports ./workbench.

decisions.choice: Rules-first NER with an injected low-confidence gateway interface; tests use a fake, no live model call.
decisions.justification: Issue says 'rules first; the AI gateway for low-confidence spans'; CLAUDE.md forbids heavy/slow local runs and ADR 0051 routes models through the AI gateway.

decisions.choice: The labelled evaluation set is synthetic fixtures committed in-repo, and the report says so.
decisions.justification: #119 real fixtures are an open human-collection issue; the issue allows 'imported ones' only after staging import (#890 R5 is post-deploy).

decisions.choice: citations/verify.ts stays allowlisted in the static test.
decisions.justification: docs/adr/0051-corpus-storage-enrichment-and-retrieval.md:103 permits citation verification internals to read page_text.
